description: This file contains the implementation of a test grain class 'ConsistencyTestGrain' used for testing transactional consistency in an Orleans-based distributed system. It defines data state, transactional methods, and recursive test logic for concurrency and consistency checks.

classes.name: ConsistencyTestGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing transactional consistency testing with recursive workload execution.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Serializable nested class representing the transactional state with writer transaction ID and sequence number.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main method executing test logic with recursion, read/write operations, and concurrency, according to provided options.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Performs a transactional read of the grain state, returning an array of observations.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs a transactional write, updating state and returning observations before and after state change.

methods.name: Recurse
methods.description: Recursive function executing parallel or sequential calls to other grains for testing purposes.
